chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
A rebellious group will kill Ammar.

key_terms.الْفِئَةُ الْبَاسِقَةُ: The rebellious group/faction, often referring to the army of Imam Ali at the Battle of Siffin
key_terms.عَمَّار: Ammar ibn Yasir, a prominent companion of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: Who will kill Ammar according to the Prophet's prophecy?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, specifically identifies the 'rebellious faction' (al-Fi'ah al-Baghiah) as the group that would kill Ammar ibn Yasir, a designation Shia scholars widely associate with the army of Imam Ali (a.s.) at the Battle of Siffin. It serves as a crucial prophetic indicator of the political and spiritual divisions within the early Muslim community, validating the righteousness of Ammar's stance despite the conflict.
